plan.ai_analysis: BABA is in a solid uptrend heading into earnings, trading above both EMAs with positive MACD and RSI at 66.1, signaling strong but not yet extreme momentum. Consensus estimates ($1.85 EPS, $38.63B revenue) are below prior quarter actuals ($2.06 EPS, $34.57B revenue), meaning the bar is set lower on earnings but higher on revenue growth expectations, a mixed setup that could go either way. The last four post-earnings moves (+9.6%, -8.5%, +4.6%, +7.9%) show consistently large swings, mostly to the upside, which fits a double-sided debit spread designed to profit from a big move in either direction rather than needing to predict direction.
